objective: Evaluate the already-prefetched Qwen3.5-4B as the general local visual-semantic fallback after PaddleOCR-VL semantic failure, using the exact same validated Figure 6/Figure 3 regions but explicit evidence questions and structured outputs that forbid curve-value estimation or unsupported facts.

runtime.selection_reason: Current vLLM natively supports Qwen3.5 hybrid multimodal models and is an official serving path for the pinned model.

caption_context_facts: Dashed curves are training error and bold curves are testing error.
The left panel is plain networks; the middle panel is ResNets; the right panel is ResNets with 110 and 1202 layers.
Plain-110 is not displayed because its error is above 60 percent.
scored_visual_facts: Left panel visible models are plain-20, plain-32, plain-44, and plain-56.
Middle panel visible models are ResNet-20, ResNet-32, ResNet-44, ResNet-56, and ResNet-110.
Right panel visible models are residual-110 and residual-1202.
No exact curve-point values should be asserted unless printed explicitly as text.

caption_context_facts: The columns are VGG-19, a 34-layer plain network, and a 34-layer residual network.
The caption states 19.6 billion FLOPs for VGG-19 and 3.6 billion FLOPs for each 34-layer network.
The caption states that dotted shortcuts increase dimensions.
scored_visual_facts: Shortcut connections are visibly present in the 34-layer residual column and absent from the 34-layer plain column.
Solid shortcut arcs connect same-dimension residual blocks.
Dotted shortcut arcs occur at stage transitions where dimensions increase.
The main residual stages visibly use channel widths 64, 128, 256, and 512.

inference_plan.sampling_rationale: Use Qwen3.5 documented non-thinking/instruct sampling settings for efficient direct answers, with a fixed seed so repeated benchmark inputs remain reproducible.

quality_boundary.note: Resource ceilings remain the current governing contract. Exceptional quality may justify a later explicit policy reconsideration, but this benchmark does not silently relax them.
